title: Pin and scope hosted evidence
responsibility: Bind authorized evidence reads to a project, branch and immutable notes/evidence revisions.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.deps
inputs.description: Collaboration API, source adapter and cache.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.actor
inputs.description: Authenticated actor whose project access is checked.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceContext.query
inputs.description: Project, entity, branch, commit and current-or-commit viewing mode.

inputs.name: hubEvidencePins.base
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubEvidencePins.query
inputs.description: Requested notes and evidence revisions, each nullable.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceScope.base
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceScope.query
inputs.description: Entity, branch, commit and viewing mode.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceContext
outputs.description: Authorized source context, branch tip and repository; current-mode requests require the selected commit to remain the tip.

outputs.name: hubEvidencePins
outputs.description: Returns nothing after accepting identical pins or reachable older revisions and replacing the context’s notes/evidence identity with the requested pins.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceScope
outputs.description: Explorer scope, head and optional first-parent revision detail, plus pinned history service. Historical commits must be reachable from the branch tip.

errors.name: forbidden
errors.description: Project ID is missing; project-access failures can also propagate.

errors.name: evidence-stale
errors.description: Current branch tip moved, or requested notes/evidence pins cannot be justified from the current pins.

errors.name: evidence-unreadable
errors.description: Branch, commit facts, reachability or entity registration cannot support the requested evidence view.
